storage: Keep in an airtight jar in a cool, dark cupboard for up to about 1 year. Dry-roast and grind small amounts just before cooking for the best aroma.
looksLike: Small, round, ridged, pale-brown to straw-coloured seeds with a warm, citrusy smell when crushed.
howToPick: General guidance, not from a source in this run: choose evenly pale-brown to greenish-tan seeds with a fresh citrus smell; avoid dusty, very dark, musty or insect-damaged seeds.
shelfLife: Whole seeds keep their flavour for about 1 year in a sealed jar; ground powder fades much sooner (general guidance).

usedIn.raw: 3 g per serving (1 tsp whole seeds, dry-roasted and ground in the kadai masala)
